|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 of [[A Fine Addition To My Collection]] (version 2 of 2). The image here is the slip on the Virtual Set 22 release sheet (PDF created 6 October 2023), cut unchanged from page 2. This is the current text. Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).

* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 22 release sheet<ref name="sheet22-20231006">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-22.pdf Virtual Set 22 release sheet] (PDF, 5 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, October 2023”; file created 6 October 2023). OR Cancel an attempt to target Grievous with a lightsaber. OR Deploy any lightsaber from your Lost Pile on Grievous (he may use it until he is no longer carrying it).” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[A Fine Addition To My Collection]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[A Fine Addition To My Collection]] (published 2 October 2023) as a printable slip under the label “•A Fine Addition To My Collection”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
